{{Top|leg}}
A '''fathership''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] operated by a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]] [[Unidentified googly-eyed species|googly-eyed aliens]]. The vessel was huge, larger than an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]], and its presence was capable of blocking out the [[Star/Legends|stars]] behind it. The [[Metal/Legends|metal]] [[Hull/Legends|hull]] of the fathership was covered in winking, [[Color/Legends|colored]] lights, and they were powerful ships capable of travelling between [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxies]].<ref name="Night">{{WEGCite|story=The Night Has a Thousand Eyes|book=Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)}}</ref>

A '''fathership''' was on the final leg of a tour of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] when they happened across a [[Space warfare/Legends|battle]] between an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Unidentified Imperial-class Star Destroyer (Rebel Alliance corvette)|Star Destroyer]] and an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Unidentified Alliance corvette|corvette]]. Misinterpreting the battle as a sporting contest, the alien crew did not like the mismatch between the two ships. Dispatching [[Alien droid|droids]], the crews of both ships were [[Stun/Legends|stunned]] and taken aboard the fathership to compete in a series of fairer competitions.<ref name="Night" />
